title: Bean
description: A self-contained, agentic work packet authored by human + AI and admitted by a human. Lives at factory/beans/<id>.yaml in the target repo. risk_tier and allowed_write_paths are PROPOSALS the controller intersects/raises against policy. Runtime queue state is NOT stored here (see event.schema.json); status is the authoring lifecycle only.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name of the target repository.

intent.description: The outcome in one or two sentences — what must be true afterward, not how.

status.description: Authoring lifecycle. Only approved beans may be queued; the controller refuses anything else.

ref.description: Path, URL, or issue id the bean was derived from.

excerpt.description: The sentence(s) in the source that produced this bean.

order.description: Human-chosen position in the run order; ties broken by id.

background.description: What a reader with no knowledge of this codebase needs before starting. Carried into the spec document.

size_budget.description: Decomposition guardrail. A bean that cannot fit is split at intake, not forced through.

invariants_ref.description: Path to an independently reviewed invariants file (human or different model family).

verify.description: How a machine (or, last resort, a human) proves this criterion. Everything but 'manual' is run by the controller inside the gate container.

run.description: argv array for kind=command; exit 0 = met.

gate_id.description: Gate id from gates.lock.yaml for kind=gate.

rubric.description: What the judge must find in the diff for kind=judge.

note.description: Instructions for a human for kind=manual (forces human review).
